title: us_short_weekend_batch4_context_packet
description: Closed-world local context packet consumed by the supported US-short batch4 weekend runner (runners/us_short_weekend_batch4.py --context). It is the documented, schema-first shape a user (or runners/us_short_weekend_batch4_context_builder.py) assembles from batch1 account state + explicitly supplied local batch2/3 fixture inputs + reviewed calendar/governance/private paths. This is an OFFLINE packet only: it carries NO provider call, network, broker, order, or live authorization, and the runner keeps live hard-blocked. STRUCTURE only — the orchestrator (engine/us_short_weekend_orchestrator.py) still enforces the deep SEMANTIC gates (PIT 来源对账, price-clock match, selection->analysis seam coverage, provider-health, run-mode/calendar). Real packets carry ticker/holding/score data and must be written to a gitignored private path (the builder enforces this); the tracked example templates are synthetic / no-secret. The 7 *_path / *_root keys point at local artifacts; the other 12 keys are the batch2/3 analysis layer plus the source-bound paper-track status.

universe.description: Pass1-eligible universe rows (batch2/3). Empty for an empty run.

catalyst_recall_feed.description: Optional catalyst recall feed = a list of canonical US ticker strings (the exact runtime type consumed by inject_catalyst_recall: list|null), null when absent. NOT an object.

holdings.description: Current holdings with signals; tickers MUST reconcile 1:1 with account_state.positions (enforced by the runner/builder, not by JSON Schema).

candidate_pass2_signals.description: Per-ticker Pass2 signal payloads keyed by ticker.

per_ticker.description: Per-ticker selection-time scores keyed by ticker (e.g. core_score, theme_momentum_score).

hot_excluded_audit.description: Optional full-universe theme heat facts from the same source-bound contract. They are joined to real exclusions after selection for audit only and never affect admission.

per_ticker.description: Decision-date, source-bound theme identity/lifecycle/seat-composition facts consumed before Top15. The default industry_heat_v1 mode explicitly leaves cross-industry discovery disabled.

eligibility_governance_path.description: Path to the reviewed eligibility governance preset (loaded + validated at runtime).

per_ticker_analysis.description: Per-ticker §4.2 analysis rows keyed by ticker; must exactly cover the admitted ∪ holdings union (seam enforced by the orchestrator).

provider_health.description: Per-source health status keyed by authorized source id (e.g. fmp, sec_edgar). The orchestrator §3.7 gate rejects unauthorized sources and no-emits on non-clean critical health.

calendar_path.description: Path to the reviewed frozen NYSE/NASDAQ calendar artifact.

account_state_path.description: Path to the private us_short_account_state.json (batch1 converter output). MUST be a provably-private/gitignored or external path — enforced by the runner/builder.

paper_track.description: Run-level model-paper producer packet. A missing upstream track must be expressed as paper_evaluable=false with a source_id evidence_ref, never as a fabricated normal guard status.

prior_regime.description: Prior-week regime label, or null on the first run.

sizing_per_ticker.description: Per-ticker sizing inputs keyed by ticker (e.g. discount_mults, liquidity_cap_shares); empty for an empty run. Bucket dollars + available cash are derived from account_state, not from this map.

per_ticker.description: Non-theme probe facts only. Theme identity/lifecycle is joined inside the orchestrator from theme_selection_contract or private holding reconciliation; callers may not inject it here.

cost_inputs.description: Per-ticker cost inputs; may be empty.

forward_policy_comparison_reminder.description: Optional de-identified US-short A1 comparison-track reminder injected only by the capstone bridge; advisory-only and never a selection input.

soft_discovery_receipt_paths.description: Optional §4c receipt references. The report derives its banner by re-reading these receipts; no text is caller-supplied.

lifecycle_register_path.description: Path to the private lifecycle register (required, or initialized once via the runner's --bootstrap-lifecycle).

lifecycle_readiness_out_path.description: Optional private path for the lifecycle readiness sidecar; null to skip.

runs_private_root.description: Private (gitignored / external) root for the machine-record layer.

weekly_private_root.description: Private (gitignored / external) root for the weekly report + action table.
